items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I saw Speed, Speedy... Speedy worked with Luckey Roberts and them.

ctx.x: I found when I got to New York... I looked around and saw all the virtuoso guitar players (there wasn't many [?] banjo players, and they weren't doing much. They were with tramp bands, or they were working in dives and... I saw Banjo Bernie come through, and I saw Speed, Speedy... Speedy worked with Luckey Roberts and them. And I looked in the big bands, and in Charlie Johnson's band was Bobby Johnson, who was neat, cool, clean, didn't have too much to say, tended to business -- a banjo player. There was guys…
There was [John] Truehart in Chick Webb's band, who was the master and the boss of rhythm. Everybody remarked how great he was.
